parsed.summary: No functional anomaly is supported by the netlist: the power mux, buck regulator, high-side heater switch, three MAX31855 SPI thermocouple channels, ESP32-C3, USB-C/barrel inputs, fan-tach protection, and WS2812 status LED all match the intended architecture despite reference-number reassignment.
